title: Zed registry persistence shadow contract
description: Imported from the existing SeaORM entities. Generated output is shadow-only until the explicit authority promotion gate passes.

x-lib-core.migrationPolicy: generated shadow SQL MUST NOT be applied to any database

User.description: Local projection of a Shared Auth principal; no cross-database foreign key is allowed.

OrgMember.description: Organization membership with the existing composite primary key.

OrgInvitation.description: Organization invitation; only the invite-token hash is durable.

ProjectMember.description: Project membership with the existing composite primary key.

ProjectInvitation.description: Project invitation; only the invite-token hash is durable.

Package.description: Registry package. Download counters remain database-trigger maintained.

PackageVersion.description: Immutable package-version metadata and R2 artifact address.

DependencyGraphArtifact.description: Immutable, content-addressed dependency-graph document; normalized edges are a derived relational index.

DependencyGraphEdge.description: Ordered normalized edge derived from one immutable dependency-graph document.

PackageUpload.description: Publish-attempt record retained for completed, failed, and aborted uploads.

PackageDownload.description: Append-only download event; database triggers own counter updates.

ApiToken.description: API token metadata; only token hashes are durable.

EntityEmbedding.description: Polymorphic entity embedding stored as jsonb plus an explicit dimension count.
